SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT S.DOCNUM + CAST(S.DOCLIN AS VARCHAR) AS LINKROWID ,S.[DOCTYP] ,S.[DOCNUM] ,S.[DOCLIN] ,S.[CPNITMNO] ,ITM.ITMNAM ,ITM.ITMSPEC ,S.[CPNITMVER] ,S.[QTY] ,S.[UOM] ,S.[UOMCOE] ,S.[QTYSTU] , -- 根据不同SRCTYP取对应库存 CASE WHEN S.[SRCTYP] = 'UOM' THEN STK_UOM.STKQTY -- UOM类型的库存 WHEN S.[SRCTYP] = 'STU' THEN STK_STU.STKQTYSTU -- STU类型的库存 ELSE 0 END AS STKQTY ,LY.LYQTY ,S.[LOC] ,DBO.Optdes('DOCSTA', S.DOCSTA) [LDOCSTA] ,S.[REMARK] [LREMARK] ,S.[SRCTYP] ,S.[CREUSR] ,S.[UPDUSR] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.[CRETIM], 21) AS CRETIM ,CASE WHEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.UPDTIM, 21) = '1900-01-01 00:00' THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.UPDTIM, 21) END AS UPDTIM ,S.[CLOREA] AS [LCLOREA] ,IIF(S.CLOSTA = 1, '是', '否') LCLOSTA ,S.[CLOUSR] , CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),S.[CLOTIM], 21) [CLOTIM] ,CASE WHEN S.DOCSTA = '1'AND S.CLOSTA = 0 THEN '' ELSE '1' END AS LDEBFLG ,CASE WHEN S.DOCSTA IN ( '1', '2' ) AND S.CLOSTA = 0 THEN '' ELSE '1' END AS LCLBFLG FROM [MFGPKL] S INNER JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO = S.CPNITMNO -- 分别关联不同类型的库存 LEFT JOIN (SELECT S.ITMNO ,SUM(S.QTY) AS STKQTY FROM [STK] S INNER JOIN ITM I ON S.ITMNO = I.ITMNO WHERE S.UOM <> 'KG' -- UOM类型排除KG AND I.TCLCOD = 'RW' GROUP BY S.ITMNO) STK_UOM ON STK_UOM.ITMNO = S.CPNITMNO AND S.[SRCTYP] = 'UOM' LEFT JOIN (SELECT S.ITMNO ,SUM(S.QTYSTU) AS STKQTYSTU FROM [STK] S INNER JOIN ITM I ON S.ITMNO = I.ITMNO WHERE I.TCLCOD = 'RW' GROUP BY S.ITMNO) STK_STU ON STK_STU.ITMNO = S.CPNITMNO AND S.[SRCTYP] = 'STU' LEFT JOIN (SELECT SRCDOC ,SRCLIN ,SUM(QTY) LYQTY FROM STKCHG WHERE SUBSTA = 3 AND DOCGRP = 'MPM' AND SRCDOC = '{0}' GROUP BY SRCDOC ,SRCLIN) LY ON S.DOCNUM = LY.SRCDOC AND S.DOCLIN = LY.SRCLIN WHERE S.[DOCNUM] = '{0}' ORDER BY S.DOCLIN;
SysDataModelXML.SQLRemove: DELETE FROM [MFGPKL] WHERE DOCNUM + Cast(DOCLIN AS VARCHAR) = '#LINKROWID#' AND DOCSTA = '1'
